title: 第15章  实战冰寒霜狼第16章  主人为什么不抱我
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
翌日，清晨。
房门口，身着黑色短裙的夜离殇，换好鞋子后，她伸手将正在和御兽口粮奋战的云绒狐抱了起来，顺手拿起一盒御兽口粮放入口袋中。
“雪球，我们该去上学了。”
“你要是没吃饱的话，到学院再继续吃。”
夜离殇说着，就打开了房门，径直走了出去。
但仿佛是突然想到了什么一样，刚走出房门的夜离殇，又转身看向坐在沙发上的龙疏寒，道：“龙阿姨，茶几上有房门钥匙，你要是出去的话，记得把钥匙带上。”
“知道了。”
龙疏寒答应一声，就眼含笑意地目送夜离殇离开。
等房门关上后，龙疏寒就躺在沙发上，将腿搭在一起，眼中出现几分沉思。
“梦离，你什么时候才回来呢？”
“离殇这小丫头，我还是很喜欢的，等你回来以后，我当个干妈应该不过分吧。”
龙疏寒喃喃自语，指尖则是轻轻摩挲着什么。
……
沧澜高中。
夜离殇才刚刚进入校门，就听到凌沧海的声音从后方响起。
“夜同学，你今天来的可有点晚了。”
凌沧海拎着早点，向着夜离殇的方向走来。
“老师。”
夜离殇停下步伐，看看现在的时间，确实是有点晚了，已经属于迟到了。
但夜离殇在将目光投向凌沧海的时候，眼中却闪过一抹沉思。

嗯～
她确实是迟到了。
可凌沧海似乎也才刚来，也属于是迟到了。
“不愧是我们七班的天才，短短两天的时间，云绒狐就已经达到三级了吗？”
“不错，不错。”
凌沧海推了推眼镜，观察着趴在夜离殇肩膀上的云绒狐，啧啧称赞。
“老师谬赞了。”
夜离殇低声谦虚了一句。
“夜同学，你也不用谦虚。”
“我当初要是有你的天赋，我当年要是有你这天赋，在学院里估计都要嚣张得横着走了。”
凌沧海哈哈一笑，声音中带着感慨。
“夜同学，你不用去教室了，直接前往七班的战斗训练室吧，接下来的课程是战斗方面的训练，稍后我也会带着其他学生过去的。”
凌沧海伸手指了一个方向，随后就往教室的方向走去。
而夜离殇则是前往了战斗训练室。
战斗训练室在教室的反方向。
整体结构是一个椭圆形的建筑，其中共有七角训练室，对应高三年级的七个班级。
进入属于七班的战斗训练室，就见这里极为宽阔，中央是巨大的战斗训练区域，地面铺着高强度抗御兽合金板，两侧有着可容纳一整个班级学生的台阶平台，一排排的金属座椅排列得整整齐齐。
整体给人一种整洁且坚固的感觉。
在平台处选择一个座位坐下后，夜离殇看到在下方的战斗训练区域中有一个巨大的铁笼，一只体型在一米五左右，身形矫健匀称，全身覆盖着灰白色毛发的冰寒霜狼正被关押在铁笼中。
content_en:
The next day, early morning.
At the door of the room, Ye Lishang was wearing a black short skirt. After changing her shoes, she reached out to pick up the Yunrong Fox who was struggling with the beast rations. She picked up a box of beast rations and put it in her pocket.
"Snowball, it's time for us to go to school."
"If you are not full, you can continue eating at the academy."
Ye Lishang said, opened the door and walked out.
But as if something suddenly occurred to him, Ye Lishang, who had just walked out of the room, turned to look at Long Shuhan who was sitting on the sofa and said: "Aunt Long, there is a door key on the coffee table. If you go out, remember to take the key with you."
"Got it."
Long Shuhan agreed and watched Ye Lishang leave with a smile in his eyes.
After the door was closed, Long Shuhan lay on the sofa, crossing his legs with a look of deep thought in his eyes.
"Mengli, when will you come back?"
"I still like this little girl Li Shang. When you come back, it shouldn't be too much for me to be your godmother."
Long Shuhan murmured to himself, while his fingertips gently rubbed something.
…
Canglan High School.
Ye Lishang had just entered the school gate when he heard Ling Canghai's voice coming from behind.
"Classmate Ye, you came a little late today."
Ling Canghai carried breakfast and walked towards Ye Lishang.
"Teacher."
Ye Lishang stopped and looked at the time. It was indeed a bit late. It was already late.
But when Ye Lishang turned his gaze to Ling Canghai, a flash of contemplation flashed in his eyes.
Hmm~
She was indeed late.
But Ling Canghai seemed to have just arrived, so he was late.
"As expected of the genius of our Class Seven, Yunrong Fox has already reached level three in just two days?"
"Not bad, not bad."
Ling Canghai pushed up his glasses, observed Yun Ronghu lying on Ye Lishang's shoulder, and praised him.
"The teacher is so complimentary."
Ye Li Shang whispered modestly.
"Classmate Ye, you don't have to be modest."
"If I had your talent back then, I would have been so arrogant that I walked away in the academy."
Ling Canghai laughed, with emotion in his voice.
"Student Ye, you don't need to go to the classroom. Go directly to the combat training room of Class 7. The next course is combat training. I will take other students there later."
Ling Canghai pointed in a direction and then walked towards the classroom.
Ye Lishang went to the combat training room.
The combat training room is in the opposite direction of the classroom.
The overall structure is an oval building with seven corners of training rooms, corresponding to the seven classes of the third grade.
Entering the combat training room belonging to Class 7, you can see that it is extremely spacious. In the center is a huge combat training area. The floor is paved with high-strength resistance beast alloy plates. There are step platforms on both sides that can accommodate an entire class of students. Rows of metal seats are neatly arranged.
The overall feel is neat and solid.
After choosing a seat on the platform and sitting down, Ye Lishang saw a huge iron cage in the combat training area below. A frost wolf about 1.5 meters tall, with a strong and well-proportioned body and a body covered with gray-white hair was being imprisoned in the iron cage.
